title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.10 — Fixed shell completions for Bash, Zsh, and Fish
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.10 — 修复 Bash、Zsh 与 Fish 自动补全

text.en_US: Fixed Zsh completion state machine indexing, added portable environment fallback for Bash, and refined Fish subcommand completions.
text.zh_CN: 重构修复了 Zsh 补全状态机与下标索引问题；增加了 Bash 补全环境 fallback；优化了 Fish 补全的子命令匹配。
